final_message:
Configured the 31 authoritative zones on pc1–pc31 with 30 delegations and glue records. pc32 is the recursive resolver at `10.15.8.14`, and pc33–pc40 use it for DNS.

Added the requested service and MX records. I assumed pc6’s existing address for `www.example.com`, since the lab identifies no separate web host. The topology, addresses, routes, and machine images remain unchanged.

The delegation count and representative records passed static inspection. Runtime resolution and BIND syntax checks remain unverified because the BIND checking utilities are unavailable locally.
